body:
could we not import these types from ui-components? or did you not do it to keep the implementation types private? an alternative would also be to implement ai-lite as a separate package (also published) that both ui components and InstantSearch.js rely on.

In the mean time I'm ok with the duplication as these types likely won't change.
can be in a separate PR, but we likely no longer need the umd special casing for this widget now, right? As no "modern" (proxies, zod) code will be loaded in advance anymore, which was the umd issue

Yeah this and the fact that it's `instantsearch.js` that actually implements it... could be fine if we import it from a different endpoint like `instantsearch-ui-components/types/ai-lite` or something.
We can do that if the types really do change
Did it in there, it's just a single file change now actually
